battles.message_after_text: Having crashed the gate, the whole town guard will be after your hide.

battles.message_before_text: A few gnaths discover you wandering about.
A few gnaths discover you wandering about.
You storm the camp.  The gnaths quickly form into squads.  There are two squads of veterans and two squads of younger troops.  Three massive hill giants lead the squads and bark orders.
battles.message_after_text: It was a difficult battle, but you are victorious.  Most of the take consists of  fairly common items.  However, the hut contains several odd items of interest.

battles.message_before_text: The sounds of combat ring out nearby.  You rush to the scene and see the kings' men fiercely engaged in battle with a patrol of ogres led by a giant.  The kings' men fight valiantly, but they are being overpowered.  You jump into the fray!
battles.message_after_text: You tend to the wounded.  Many have died, any many more are in great agony.  Local clerics arrive and bless you for your help in driving off the invaders.

battles.message_before_text: Gnaths continue to pour out of the mountain passage.  Many initial shock troops have fallen as a result of your superior combat skills.  The gnath ranks are now diluted with younger warriors, but they are still an effective fighting force.

The carnage continues.  The death toll mounts.  You try to catch your breath.  A third squad of gnaths emerges from the mountain and presses the attack.  They have been reduced to young warriors with only a few veterans.  Your side fares no better.
You spot a pair of dwarven warriors during the fray.  They are sorely pressed and bleeding badly.
